Computer control can capture an authorized app's windows without including other apps. Screenshot input stays bound to the observed app and geometry, and native actions return a fresh capture of the app they acted on. Zoom retains that app boundary. Explicit display capture remains available when requested.

A canceled permission prompt can no longer activate an app or change the next chat's permissions when its answer arrives late.

Bundles gateway 0.16.34 (protocol 93), with window-scoped Linux control and bounded native operations. Build 29. Existing state already converted for gateway 0.16.33 needs no further conversion.
